svg.title: WRAP_SKIRT master pattern, size Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study (1 unit = 1 mm)

g.data-size: Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study

g.text: WRAP_SKIRT size Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study
Join side seams to both overlapping fronts. Match centre-back notch to waistband.

g.data-size: Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study

g.text: WRAP_SKIRT size Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study
Cut mirror pair (R overwrap, L underwrap). Hem front wrap edges before attaching waistband.

g.data-size: Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study

g.text: WRAP_SKIRT size Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study
Attach to joined skirt waist (1020 mm total). Work a 20 mm buttonhole at the right side-seam slot for the inner tie.

g.data-size: Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study

g.text: WRAP_SKIRT size Fixed 1020 mm wrap - synthetic adult study
Cut two 780 x 70 mm ties, seam to waistband ends, fold lengthwise to 35 mm finished strap, and topstitch.
